listing_active_has_price.name: listing_active_has_price
listing_active_has_price.value: "listing"."status" not in ('active', 'reserved') or ("listing"."type" = 'sale' and "listing"."sale_price" is not null) or ("listing"."type" = 'rent' and "listing"."monthly_rent" is not null)

listing_price_matches_type.name: listing_price_matches_type
listing_price_matches_type.value: ("listing"."type" = 'sale' and "listing"."monthly_rent" is null and "listing"."key_money" is null and "listing"."advance_amount" is null and "listing"."lease_duration_months" is null) or ("listing"."type" = 'rent' and "listing"."sale_price" is null)
